review.assessment:
The change replaces `money.quantize(running)` (which rounds to nearest cent, presumably using standard rounding) with `math.ceil(running * money.CENTS - money.EPSILON) / money.CENTS`, which always rounds UP or stays at the current cent. The intent is to ensure the displayed total never falls below the sum of printed line amounts, achieving internal consistency between per-line totals and the invoice TOTAL.

All 18 acceptance tests pass, confirming no regressions in the test suite.
